result:
The new binary isn't slower: da42990-v3 runs at the same speed as e74f200-v3, about +0.7% CPU time, which is within noise.

User CPU time per run, 23 cells on 03.08, binaries run one at a time and interleaved:
- e74f200-v3: 112.7 / 113.0 / 112.1 s
- da42990-v3: 113.4 / 113.8 s

The third da42990-v3 run was still going when I wrote this up.

The "114 vs 137 s" was a difference in Steam Deck load, not in code. The 114 s reference was measured on an idle Deck. The gate ran at load 7–10 while the П-08 queue was running.

a5d4e3a is consistently about 3.5% slower. It was built without `target-cpu=x86-64-v3`, and da42990-v3 contains the same TK-012 changes without the slowdown, so the build flags are the cause.

Nothing to speed up. П-09 and Jan–Jun run on `bin/alpha-da42990-v3`. The ticket stays `waiting` / `wait_for: mention`; the next step belongs to the researcher once the owner gives the "ок" on П-09.
